name: CREST
recent: Crest Group Berhad 近期有多项董事及主要股东权益变动申报，包括财务总监在公开市场增持股份。公司公布截至2026年6月30日季度业绩，营收环比增长20.2%，但净利同比下滑39.6%。
notable: 财务总监 Khor Seng Chee 于2026年10月20日至21日期间在公开市场增持公司股份。
董事 Lim Siong Wai、Yap Kian Meng 及 Au Chun Mun 于2026年9月1日通过间接权益各增持100,000股。
公司公布截至2026年6月30日季度业绩，营收46.425百万令吉，净利2.023百万令吉。
risks: 净利同比下滑39.6%，净利率由5.2%降至4.4%。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为46.425百万令吉，环比增长20.2%，同比增长1.6%；净利为2.023百万令吉，环比增长0.8%，同比下滑39.6%；净利率为4.4%，低于上一季度的5.2%。

recent_en: Crest Group Berhad recently saw several director and substantial shareholder interest change filings, including open-market acquisitions by the Financial Controller. The company reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue up 20.2% QoQ but net profit down 39.6% YoY.
notable_en: Financial Controller Khor Seng Chee acquired shares in the open market between 20 and 21 October 2026.
Directors Lim Siong Wai, Yap Kian Meng and Au Chun Mun each acquired 100,000 shares via indirect interest on 1 September 2026.
The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026, with revenue of MYR 46.425 million and net profit of MYR 2.023 million.
risks_en: Net profit declined 39.6% YoY, with net margin falling from 5.2% to 4.4%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 46.425 million, up 20.2% QoQ and 1.6% YoY; net profit was MYR 2.023 million, up 0.8% QoQ but down 39.6% YoY; net margin was 4.4%, lower than 5.2% in the previous quarter.
